fields.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
fields.description: World-renowned for the Great Migration, Maasai Mara offers unparalleled wildlife viewing. Home to the Big Five and over 450 bird species, this iconic reserve provides authentic safari experiences with traditional Maasai culture.
fields.best_time_to_visit: July to October (Great Migration), January to February
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Hot air balloon safaris, Maasai village visits, Bird watching, Photography

fields.name: Amboseli National Park
fields.description: Famous for its large elephant herds and stunning views of Mount Kilimanjaro. Amboseli offers excellent wildlife photography opportunities with Africa's highest mountain as a backdrop.
fields.best_time_to_visit: June to October, January to February
fields.popular_activities: Elephant watching, Game drives, Bird watching, Maasai cultural tours, Photography

fields.name: Diani Beach
fields.description: Pristine white sand beach on the Indian Ocean coast. Perfect for relaxation, water sports, and marine life encounters. Consistently ranked among Africa's best beaches.
fields.best_time_to_visit: December to March, July to October
fields.popular_activities: Snorkeling, Scuba diving, Kite surfing, Dolphin watching, Beach relaxation

fields.name: Nairobi City
fields.description: Kenya's vibrant capital city blending modern urban life with wildlife experiences. Home to museums, markets, restaurants, and the only national park within a capital city.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round
fields.popular_activities: Nairobi National Park, Giraffe Centre, Karen Blixen Museum, Shopping, Dining

fields.name: Mount Kenya
fields.description: Africa's second-highest mountain offering challenging treks and stunning alpine scenery. A UNESCO World Heritage Site with diverse ecosystems from bamboo forests to glaciers.
fields.best_time_to_visit: January to February, August to September
fields.popular_activities: Mountain climbing, Hiking, Wildlife viewing, Photography, Camping

fields.name: Tsavo National Park
fields.description: Kenya's largest national park, divided into Tsavo East and West. Famous for red elephants, diverse landscapes, and the man-eating lions of Tsavo legend.
fields.best_time_to_visit: June to October, January to February
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Bird watching, Mzima Springs visit, Rock climbing, Photography

fields.name: Lake Nakuru National Park
fields.description: Famous for millions of flamingos creating a pink shoreline. Home to both black and white rhinos, making it a crucial conservation area.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, best June to March
fields.popular_activities: Flamingo watching, Rhino tracking, Game drives, Bird watching, Baboon Cliff viewpoint

fields.name: Watamu
fields.description: Coastal paradise with pristine beaches, coral reefs, and marine national park. Perfect for diving, snorkeling, and turtle watching.
fields.best_time_to_visit: October to March
fields.popular_activities: Snorkeling, Scuba diving, Turtle watching, Deep sea fishing, Beach walks

fields.name: Lamu Island
fields.description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with Swahili culture and architecture. Car-free island with donkeys as main transport, offering a step back in time.
fields.best_time_to_visit: July to March
fields.popular_activities: Dhow sailing, Cultural tours, Beach relaxation, Swahili cuisine, Historical sites

fields.name: Samburu National Reserve
fields.description: Remote northern reserve with unique wildlife including Grevy's zebra, reticulated giraffe, and Somali ostrich. Rich Samburu culture and dramatic landscapes.
fields.best_time_to_visit: June to October, December to March
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Samburu cultural visits, Bird watching, River walks, Photography

fields.name: Hell's Gate National Park
fields.description: Unique park where you can walk, cycle, and rock climb among wildlife. Dramatic gorges, geothermal features, and inspiration for The Lion King.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round
fields.popular_activities: Cycling, Rock climbing, Hiking, Gorge walking, Wildlife viewing

fields.name: Mombasa
fields.description: Historic coastal city with beautiful beaches, Fort Jesus, and vibrant Swahili culture. Gateway to Kenya's coast with rich Arab and Portuguese influences.
fields.best_time_to_visit: December to March, July to October
fields.popular_activities: Fort Jesus tours, Beach visits, Old Town exploration, Water sports, Dining

fields.name: Lake Naivasha
fields.description: Freshwater lake surrounded by flower farms and wildlife. Boat rides among hippos, Crescent Island walks, and nearby Hell's Gate make it perfect for day trips.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round
fields.popular_activities: Boat rides, Crescent Island walks, Bird watching, Cycling, Flower farm tours

fields.name: Malindi
fields.description: Historic coastal town with Italian influences, beautiful beaches, and marine park. Vasco da Gama pillar and vibrant nightlife.
fields.best_time_to_visit: October to March
fields.popular_activities: Beach relaxation, Snorkeling, Historical tours, Water sports, Dining

fields.name: Ol Pejeta Conservancy
fields.description: Leading wildlife conservancy and home to the last two northern white rhinos. Chimpanzee sanctuary and excellent Big Five viewing.
fields.best_time_to_visit: June to October, January to February
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Rhino tracking, Chimpanzee sanctuary visit, Night drives, Conservation tours

fields.name: Aberdare National Park
fields.description: Misty mountain park with waterfalls, bamboo forests, and unique tree hotels. Home to elephants, leopards, and rare bongo antelope.
fields.best_time_to_visit: January to February, June to September
fields.popular_activities: Tree hotel stays, Waterfall visits, Trout fishing, Forest walks, Wildlife viewing

fields.name: Nairobi National Park
fields.description: Unique park with city skyline backdrop. Only 7km from city center, offering quick safari experiences with lions, rhinos, and giraffes.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round, best June to February
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Picnics, Bird watching, Photography, Animal orphanage visit

fields.name: Giraffe Centre
fields.description: Conservation center in Nairobi where you can feed and interact with endangered Rothschild giraffes. Educational and family-friendly experience.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round
fields.popular_activities: Giraffe feeding, Nature walks, Educational tours, Photography, Gift shopping

fields.name: Karen Blixen Museum
fields.description: Historic farmhouse of 'Out of Africa' author Karen Blixen. Beautiful colonial architecture and gardens offering glimpse into Kenya's colonial past.
fields.best_time_to_visit: Year-round
fields.popular_activities: Museum tours, Garden walks, Photography, Historical learning, Coffee at cafe

fields.name: Meru National Park
fields.description: Remote wilderness park made famous by 'Born Free' lioness Elsa. Diverse landscapes with rivers, swamps, and excellent wildlife including rare species.
fields.best_time_to_visit: June to September, December to March
fields.popular_activities: Game drives, Elsa's grave visit, Bird watching, River walks, Photography
